page_title: BOC 1-1 EIN | Bochum v Eintracht Frankfurt 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Benjamin Brand has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' A player from Bochum commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+4' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Tuta will be replaced by Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90' Here's the change. Buta leaves the pitch and Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
89' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
87' Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to find Buta, but he puts too much power on the pass.
86' The ball is out of play. Bochum win a corner kick.
84' Thomas Letsch prepares a substitution. Kevin Stoger is replaced by Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mario Gotze trots off the pitch and is replaced by Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt).
80' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) picks up a yellow card.
79' Eintracht Frankfurt have a free kick.
76' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
76' The ball goes out of play and Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
74' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Kevin Stoger (Bochum) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Kevin Trapp no chance!
74' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
73' This is a yellow card! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
73' Benjamin Brand interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt). PENALTY! One of the players from Bochum is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
72' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bochum.
70' The referee is firm and issues Kevin Stoger (Bochum) a deserved yellow card.
69' Thomas Letsch has decided to make a change. Philipp Forster (Bochum) replaces Anthony Losilla.
69' Substitution. Takuma Asano did his best and is replaced by Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
63' Here comes a substitution. Maximilian Wittek is given a rest as he is replaced by Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum).
63' Thomas Letsch has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) replacing Philipp Hofmann.
60' The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner.
58' Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

57' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Manuel Riemann, so the score changes to 0:1.
56' The Eintracht Frankfurt players joy may have been justified, because referee Benjamin Brand is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
55' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
52' Eintracht Frankfurt enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
48' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) will take the free kick.
46' Here is a change. Niels Nkounkou is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jessic Ngankam as he is replaced by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Benjamin Brand has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Felix Passlack (Bochum) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Great teamplay by Bochum as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
39' A pass by Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
38' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
37' A cross by Matus Bero (Bochum) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
33' A quickly taken corner by Bochum.
31' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for an infringement.
30' A long ball forward to Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted.
26' Bochum are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
22' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Manuel Riemann.
19' Bochum control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
16' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the resulting free kick, but no praise for this shot as it blazes high over the bar.
16' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes a direct free kick.
15' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
15' The ball goes behind for a corner. Bochum will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
11' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

8' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Riemann was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
4' Surely that's handball by one of the Eintracht Frankfurt players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
4' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bochum are going to take it.

4' A great job from two opposing players there. Kevin Stoger (Bochum) fired a shot nicely in on goal from distance towards the roof of the net, while Kevin Trapp produced a wonderful piece of goalkeeping to parry the ball onto the bar. Bochum get a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bochum will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Benjamin Brand.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
